Alert.description: A result that changed its check's state (spec 041).
Alert.title: Alert

AlertCheck.description: The check as the registry has it: a retired one's alerts outlive it.
AlertCheck.title: AlertCheck

CheckChange.description: A recent change to a check, from the registry (spec 042).
CheckChange.title: CheckChange

CheckDetail.description: One check with its rule: what `GET /checks/{id}` serves.
CheckDetail.title: CheckDetail

CheckSource.description:
A check's own lines in its file, as loaded: `GET /checks/{id}/source`.

`text` is only the check's lines (and the comments directly around it);
`filter` is the one other value from the same file. When the lines could
not be told apart, `start_line`, `end_line` and `text` are null.
CheckSource.title: CheckSource

CheckSql.description:
The SQL a check compiles to, without connecting: `GET /checks/{id}/sql`.

`sql` is shown with values inlined and without a trailing `;`; a run
sends the same statement with bound parameters. Nothing about the
datasource but its name and dialect is served.

items.description: Open on `kind`: a later version may add kinds, and a client ignores a statement whose kind it does not know.

CheckSql.title: CheckSql

CheckSummary.description:
A named check. `metric`, `unit` and `rule` are its clause's when it has
one clause; with several, `metric` is `"check"`, `unit` is null and
`clauses` lists them.
CheckSummary.title: CheckSummary

ClauseSummary.description: One clause of a named check, as loaded.
ClauseSummary.title: ClauseSummary

Definition.description: One version of a check's definition (spec 038).
Definition.title: Definition

DefinitionClause.description: One clause of a definition version, as it was written.
DefinitionClause.title: DefinitionClause

DefinitionList.description: A check's definition versions, newest first.
DefinitionList.title: DefinitionList

FileFilter.description: The check file's dataset `filter:`, as loaded.
FileFilter.title: FileFilter

LastEvaluated.description: What the data last showed, when the latest result could not be evaluated.
LastEvaluated.title: LastEvaluated

QueryStatement.description: A statement of the check's own, such as a duplicate count.
QueryStatement.title: QueryStatement

RecordedClause.description: One clause of a retired check, as its last result recorded it.
RecordedClause.title: RecordedClause

RetiredCheckSummary.description:
A check gone from the project's files (spec 037), as last recorded.

It has no file, rule or SQL any more. What it measured comes from its
last result: `expression`, `metric` and `last_known_location` are null
and `clauses` empty for a check that never ran.
RetiredCheckSummary.title: RetiredCheckSummary

Rule.description:
The check's conditions as this server loaded them.

Built only from the parsed expectation and triggers — never from options
such as `valid_values`, or from `where:`/`filter:` SQL.
Rule.title: Rule

ScanColumn.description: A column of the scan this check uses. `shared_by` counts other checks.
ScanColumn.title: ScanColumn

ScanStatement.description: The dataset's single scan: every aggregate of every loaded check on it.
ScanStatement.title: ScanStatement

Settings.description: The served project's configuration, read-only and without credentials.
Settings.title: Settings

SettingsResults.description:
The results store, never its URL: it may hold a password, and a
SQLite path names the server's file system (spec 040 S-D2).
SettingsResults.title: SettingsResults

get.description: The project's state changes, newest first, with their deliveries.
Recent changes to the project's checks, newest first (spec 042).
A check's definition versions, newest first: a retired check's too.

The configuration as loaded at startup, and the store's schema.

Answers even when the store cannot be read: that is when someone looks.
